facts.fact: Africa Data Centres' page describes its JHB1 Midrand colocation data centre (8 data halls, 9,000 m2 white space) as operating, with private cages, secured racks and cross connects; the page date is a capture proxy.

Africa Data Centres states that the Midrand JHB1 site, being expanded by four halls and 10 MW, is built to a Tier-4 standard; this is an operator statement with no Uptime certification named, and the page date is a capture proxy.
